author: danielkuye
body:
![jeremy-bishop-vGjGvtSfys4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23uR7LefN6QZF2LToHZLqjmnAwSEb2gUgpjtTSH215dmnp9D7tEuuNwE4EbQxhuZpmDXS.jpg)


Hello everyone"

Welcome to Hive Blockchain a place of opportunities and self development to everyone who's a Hivian,a place where you can grow your world and make a change around you both financially and interlectualy,all you need is just to put your mind to work,I can assure you that it's not an easy flow thing,we know that every success has to be builded from the scratch,so if you want to give life a fight and win then get to work.


![nik-z1d-LP8sjuI-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23yd3i2hETztRtfhXbpv3nkYa7xK9GbWVxG9WwwAK9bfYEkCEFL3kQ4hMAVH5Kmwrbg3h.jpg)


* As we all know, the platform is like your empty room,fill it up with your vital items,so that who ever comes in will like to stay,I have come to realize that Hive is a very large world, it's a one platform for many people who are willing to build success,put in much effort just to get a  colorful results,I have heard people share their testimonies about HIVE and it's not a thing to joke about I think,let this platform inspire you to challenge yourself for growth, I have some key things to share that will help grow you faster and better.


![olena-bohovyk-DmeZC9riGkk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23uQpMmmst2vVHeLySafiBHbhvHnDMmhPMkPwGAHjmBFcw3tpUG9d6oV3WHXNQag1Xriw.jpg)


* CREATE THE BEST YOU CAN.
As a Hivian you should double up your pursuit for excellence, observe what you post on a daily bases and have a way of detecting wether you are growing or not in every post you make,the drive to creating good contents should never drop low even if the demand is high and you have limited time to meet up, stick to your brand,what ever content you create in Hive exposes to people the power of your mind.


![gabriel-gurrola-2UuhMZEChdc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23vrtNmtp8Z87exxj6ecqbz846f42VoWbt8Sfgbdnyf2DoL2QX91BVa857vkjfLwuPUhf.jpg)


* THE HIVIAN'S ACTIVITY.
We all are known for a specific gift or talents,but when it comes to exploring into the public you have to employ diversity in your gift as different people are expecting different thing from one source and that's you,for instance; if you are a writer,your writing should affect different areas of life and even cultures that are not yours,that means you have to put yourself to studies and research,and if  you are a singer,you should be able to sing more than one genre of music even though you still maintain your uniqueness as maybe an afro singer, classic ,blues,rap or even learn one musical instrument at least,just be creative and try new things that will keep your followers engaged, good content always.


![istockphoto-2073120208-1024x1024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielkuye/23tbMPZem6gFBuLp67TnvQKwMyC6Gdg5itMzn875mx3o7NjsD2aKH41QHghciCoz3JhAe.jpg)


* BUILDING RELATIONSHIP.
Connect to different people across the universe as much as you can,one thing that has always helped me is that " where ever I go to I tend to build a bond of families where I can feel at home always"... hive is a large world don't just make post and log-out or just comment back on people who commented on your post,reach-out to people so you can build friendship.



* THE MONEY MINDSET.
We are so excited to know that we can make earnings just by posting our content and getting some reactions,one thing I know is people who place all their focus on just making money no matter how will end up Lossing all they have gathered one day,good contents should come first, chasing money is not the best mindset if you want to gain financial freedom , build a channel and money will follow through that channel on a steady,even the Bible says " seek ye first the kingdom of God and his righteousness and all other things shall be added unto you"...I think that's a word enough.


* GLOBAL RECOGNITION.
I have heard of people who are privilege to travel out to other countries without their own excess spending,they got sponsored by friend's, connecting to different people around the world is the best way to expand civilization worldwide,the world is ours,so let stroll around it, extend your boundary of friendship by meeting new people who will impact positively in your and Hive is a good place for that.


Thank you for reading.
Daniel kuye.

author: eberechi01
body:
As 2025 begins, I envisioned building and achieving a goal on hive that reflects my passion and expertise. As a creative individual I plan to produce contents that sparks creativity and intrigued individual when they read, whether it's writing, diy , sharing photography or exploring other forms of digital art. Hive is more than just a blogging platform, it is an interconnected ecosystem of content creator and writers that brings like mind individual and minds together. My vision for hive this year includes becoming knowledgeable about hive core principle and rules such as decentralization, transparency, and user empowerment, community involvement and personal development. ![pexels-bertellifotografia-29509447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eberechi01/23uR3Et5cPyHT2VGBuuFk538oaHM2zARorh7Qwz5mzs9MjZYEk8hnDggtLWiYbJK8CdeY.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/close-up-of-2025-planner-with-earphones-and-sticky-notes-29509447/)
As a newcomer to hive I am excited to explore through the amazing content written by users of great minds , although I am just beginning my journey and it's only been a year since I joined hive but I have a vision of how I can grow in hive and how the platform itself can also evolve. Consistency and quality will and always is my guiding principles, as someone who aims to do well in hive I aim to post regularly and engage actively with other users and comment thoughtfully on their post too. Over time, I hope to earn trust and recognition from the various community on hive, which will motivate me to keep improving and contributing meaningfully on hive.
Additionally, I intend to explore ways to use the hive tokens for real world application, such as investing in the hive platform and helping charitable causes or reinvesting in hive based initiative that promote innovative and sustainability. Hive thrives on creativity and my first goal is to establish as a consistent content creator and identity my niche - whether it's blogging, gaming, diy/Art or any other area of interest and focus on producing high quality post. My target per week is two post,each offering valuable insight and entertaining my audience. Overtime I aspire to create or co manage a community that serve as a hub for like minded individual to connect, collaborate and share ideas. By fostering togetherness I aim at strengthen my role within the hive ecosystem. ![goal-2045924_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eberechi01/23tc1Gbz73HBAJVzFscmtyTY5F5fWLZfg3KxBqnL34WHz76YPNxCmkftKGrBohRbDq93V.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/goal-arrive-to-achieve-set-target-2045924/)
In conclusion, planning my hive goals for 2025 will be an exciting and creative journey of self discovery, creativity and person growth. By focusing on content creation, community development and promoting hive, I hope to make an impactful meaning on hive while achieving success. With dedication and consistency, I am positive and confident that this 2025 will be a transformative and enjoyable year for my hive experience. ##
THANK YOU FOR READING THROUGH

author: coderaikiri
body:
Waking up on Monday morning to a notification highlighting the question "what are your hive goals for 2025" really caught me off guard, at first my head only registered on plans for myself as a whole and quite frankly I don't really see any difference.


![1001647101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coderaikiri/242s1dDtHUMoKNvYfNawhqtJaAxhPvgevQBZpHjDvvzUiZ6gVUdGtKfXBY3gSjzsoukDb.jpg)

After much thoughts it dawn on me that this was going to be a lot harder than it seemed  because I for one really suck at making plans, staying consistent with them and being optimistic in general. I usually have premonitions that my plans will not yield anything positive and when I try to get myself on the right track I tend to drift off that is if I don't completely abandon them in general.
Now being a complete novice with just two weeks of experience on the hive space puts me at a huge disadvantage . I am barely able to navigate around the platform so how do I produce a goal with plans towards actualization. It all seems like a hassle but that's okay, the new me has sworn to accept strives and challenges head on so this is basically what I signed up for.
With my mind running circles on how to coordinate my shortcomings, a thought came to my mind " why not read through works of people who have done theirs. This will serve as a guide and reference material to the task at hand. I sacrificed an entire night to reading posts as well as comments from the community while also reacting and dropping comments wherever I could.
I am not going to lie , I'll be needing all the help I can get and support from the community will be highly appreciated. After much research I have finally been able to draft out three goals I really need to work with as a beginner in this platform and hopefully I stick to them.

![1001658408.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coderaikiri/2458XFLL1bCh6xFbE58HVh1ktC3Tj9B6DYGsHNmS3oeGFiRgB43hZLCBdvifXx8jBT6L3.jpg)


Konnichiwa Emmanuel here. My goals for hive this 2025 came as a result of numerous research, introspection, self evaluation and assistance from the communal activities which I have categorized into three with  intent to explain before.
 For a start I plan to get myself properly acquainted with operations surrounding web3 and the hive community. I have gotten too comfortable with asking for directions here though it's a necessary process for first timer, it would really go a long way if I can navigate my affairs with minimum assistance (acknowledging the fact that nobody is above getting help). I intend on working with what Little knowledge I already possess which isn't nearly enough but with a fixated mindset I believe I can achieve the necessary tools for my growth on this platform one information at a time.
Surrounding myself with the right minds that not only understand my initiative but also share my goals will not only skyrocket my growth and potentials to rewarding proportions but also serve as a form of motivation towards future endeavors. Notwithstanding I don't intend on relenting from making research since this will serve as primary aids towards self discovery and actualization.


![1001671420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coderaikiri/23zku1BAF4UiEJtoKFi7moP7xVPAXgrHouznW532c9cuMzz8wbgKDeeSw56sNQ4tUM7ad.jpg)


 With my work predominantly revolving around content making , I plan on experimenting on a lot of activities until I am able to discover my niche. This will assist me in not just dropping contents but good quality works that not only describes what I embody but also resonate with my audience and the community as well. These contents will serve as a deterent to my pessimistic perspective being a product of my zeal/motivation to work ( I'll needing help here so that go astray🤣🤣🤣).
Last but not the least my biggest folly - Consistency. This will serve my foundation for operation , it is the key to both my success here and as a person entirely. I strive to be consistent with my search for knowledge and contributing to the hive community in my content creation gig.
With consistency being a thorn on my side I intend to embrace it by erasing the notion of negativity and starting off with the Favorite Barack Obama slogan " yes I can" every morning when I wake up and right before I sleep at night. My plans are achievable if I put my mind to it and I wholeheartedly intend to.

![1001671412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coderaikiri/2432QHywvHkgBkgijbhd72hyQnwJ4NPUfKhqJYCeRKRfxHkyccHzYmQtCJiPx9E1do7J2.jpg)


2025 is going to be one heck of a ride , I don't know about you but I plan on riding out the storm.

author: landlord7
body:
Though as we journey through another beginning, I want to use this opportunity to thank God for the privilege, his mercy and gift of life. 

Goals are a crucial part of life, they are like maps helping people to navigate their dreams.

I have so many things I wish to achieve on hive this year. I know I am just starting my journey on the  chain but I don't want to take the opportunity before me for granted. 

Before I proceed I want to wish us a happy prosperous new year. 2025 by the special grace of God will be a great year for us all. 


![1000855736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/landlord7/23x1Mzx7Sh4QbFABnok4SjDzynxHur8Ytq63yBx8YGQXcb38AoD4PBs9QrPjQCRuWboX1.jpg)
 
Now let me move to the topic at hand. Hive has become a part of me and almost every aspect is getting addicted to it. I remember when I was told about it, I was prompted to carry out research on it and  was so eager to be a part of it. All thanks to God because that dream is now a reality

 The first thing I want to work on this year on hive is to build my hive power. I have received lectures on the importance of HP and since then It has been on my mind to build it.

God's willing, before the year runs out, I am hoping to have accumulated at least 1000HP.  It sounds big for a newbie but I am so determined to make it happen. 

I want to also have big power to promote the contents of my friends and other good authors out there and I know that without a reasonable amount of hive power I can't achieve it. 


![1000726081.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/landlord7/23viCPpTYjW4Gj5sN4tRVqPasbDeuGgj8Lpx445b9JkcyzRYqTYBJQjjdVU2VzPFpPqVj.jpg)
 
Secondly, I want to  max my engagement level on hive. I have heard so much about the benefits of interacting with the post of other hive members and I want to be a partaker of those benefits. So, I will start by commenting on two posts daily on the hive-reachout community.

Thirdly, I want to be serious with posting, even though I was onboarded just ending last year but I  know I have not been so serious. This year, I want to try my best and be consistent in posting. I was surprised when I saw some people writing twice a day. I hope to reach that point someday in my blogging too.

author: hive-woodpeckers
body:
<center>![Hive_woodpeckers_in_wood_no_glass.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23x17DPrvaL6wAoitvyLvTSYTEUKFhKUCspfpzQK1tDwipqN5MBmgCa7M7HyQVcchQC5v.jpg)</center>

Good Evening to you all and thanks for stopping by and supporting us.

So today after having a couple of days of funding dropping in to the account, I decided it was time to get some tools that I had been looking at acquiring for a while now.

I ordered a Circular Saw that will speed up our wood cutting a hell of a lot quicker.
Being able to run this across the boards without needing get the big mitre saw out, this will make life a lot easier. Ordered from Amazon for £46.74. A fairly good price for a cheap circular saw. 

The benefit of it coming with 2 blades made this a steal, as long as it works well enough.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/48b3aMFm3FG21124Xy2TArv8J3sfxF9oSqL2R1RRzFWcaeetGuXuryNLiFWBVxU1hm.png)

Annoyingly it's gone down to £44.99 tonight, but if it works it will be well worth the extra £1 odd that we paid.


![hivewoodpeckers_divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23w2cfiRiaBhThUYHrZecUbMBTHczVJJS8aL47k6mKxsbHY44EcvvRnonWfzCQSf6Va79.png)

As I mentioned in previous posts, I will be using the HBD by selling it to my main account. This is mainly to save on fees. Though I will at times sell it if I cannot afford to buy the equipment for a bit.
This HBD will be being sold so that it allowed me to buy the saw now, instead of waiting another week. 

A total of 66.964 Hive has been sent to Binance to sell for GBP to fund the saw. Around $35.56. The $ to £ conversion is harsh and I will be trying to find much better ways to do this for future sells.

For future posts I will start making a list of what is bought, links to the receipts and costs and I will add them to spreadsheet for easy cross checking.

I will do my best to provide receipts, but it won't always be doable if I buy second hand items. 

Again thankyou to everyone who has supported us, I hope to be able to bring more great news soon!

![hivewoodpeckers_divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-woodpeckers/23w2cfiRiaBhThUYHrZecUbMBTHczVJJS8aL47k6mKxsbHY44EcvvRnonWfzCQSf6Va79.png)

author: ekojah
body:
My Hive Goals for 2025
Hello everyone, I am @ekojah, 
 https://img.inleo.io/DQmP9BSMP9o5bAauntXKb2vLuBexAkaedhFEDHWvGciSomn/IMG_20241211_141557_710.jpg 
 https://img.inleo.io/DQmNXzMA8NJX1Cq1q8S9PqQdD2wDcQUWADRtZVBZfTh2es1/IMG_20241222_120327_873.jpg 

based in Akwanga, and I am excited to participate in this week's prompt:Hive-Reachout Weekly Prompt 29>>"What Are Your Hive Goals For 2025?"
 As we step into 2025, I have set some ambitious goals for myself to promote Hive and grow our community.

One of my primary goals is to visit two communities every week in Akwanga, Wamba, Kokona, and Karu Local Government Area of Nasarawa State. I plan to share information about Hive and encourage people to join our community. By doing so, I hope to create awareness and inspire others to become part of the Hive ecosystem or to become hivers.

During these visits, I plan to:- Share information about Hive and its benefits- Distribute promotional materials such as flyers and brochures, Engage with community members and answer their questions,
encourage community members to join Hive and participate in discussions
As a teacher, I have also set a goal to visit schools in Akwanga and surrounding areas on a monthly basis. My aim is to create awareness among students about Hive and its benefits, empowering them to become self-directed learners and potential Hivers and to discover their hidden talents.
During these visits, I plan to Deliver presentations about Hive and its ecosystem,
Share success stories and testimonials from existing Hive members and my own success stories,- Provide guidance and support to students who are interested in joining Hive and encourage students to participate in Hive's various communities and initiatives
Daily Engagement
In addition to community and school outreach, I plan to engage with the Hive community on a daily basis. I will:Post high-quality content in the communities I belong to,Participate in discussions and engage with other community members, Share my knowledge and expertise with others,Provide support and guidance to new community members.
I also set 
referral Goals.
On a personal note, I aim to invite my friends and family to join Hive. Specifically, I plan to bring the following individuals on board:

 https://img.inleo.io/DQmUAnaJDwwTR19r3pysmfhrqN7fx14MGBn3AeX18odfhAb/IMG_20230817_110535_562_transcpr.jpg 

 Isaac Ekojah, Sam Ekojah, Martha Moses, Mr. Elias and -Mr. Kitty.
With these goals and by achieving  them, I am confident that I can make a positive impact on the Hive community and contribute to its growth and success. I am excited to embark on this journey and look forward to sharing my progress with you throughout the year!
Thank you for reading, and I wish you all the best in achieving your own Hive goals for 2025 as well.
Love you all.
### ALL PICTURES ARE MINE.

body:
![1736123587828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bmhillel/23xAM4oL71gyQ28iVkF5eBCM1tXXfg3Y4kks6puEB2G2AxqMXfdTrTVBJxtjTzovJavsS.jpg)

As we have already stepped in to the year 2025 I'm filled with excitement to share my hive goals for this year. But before I proceed into that. I'd like to take a moment in other to reflect on the importance of setting a goal and the power of community.


Setting a goal is a powerful tool that helps one clarify his or her priorities and focus on effort in other to achieve an aspirations. Setting a clear and achievable goals, one can create a roadmap of success and make steady progress towards a desired outcome. 

 
But setting a goal is not an isolated activity. When we share our goals with others and work together to achieve them, we create a sense of community and accountability that helps each and every one of us to stay inspired. 

Well what are actually my hive goals for the year 2025? I have set my mind in achieving two common objectives this year.

Reviving the spirit of engagement happens to be one of my top goals for the year 2025. I want to increase the rate of which I engage on people content within the hive community, this actually means constantly seeking out and interacting with others posts, awaking this spirit within me will help me make a conscious effort to support and uplift others.


In other to achieve this very goal, I have plan to set aside dedicated time each day to engage with my fellow hivers content and leave a meaningful comment that will add value to the conversation. I also plan to involve myself in online discussions sharing my thoughts with others on initiatives.

I hope to build a stronger relationships with other hive pro's, by increasing my engagement and also contribute to the growth and development of hive. I so much believe that engagement is actually a two way street, and by seeking out and interacting with others, I can create a positive effect and support others.

Growing hive blog chain is another key goal for me this year. This actually means introducing new members to the hive blog chain and provide them with every support and needed to get started. I believe that by growing our community, we can bring in fresh perspectives, and ideas that can help each everyone grow.

In other to achieve this set-goal I plan to reach out to several individuals to spread out the word about hive. 

Hive isn't just a place of earning I see it an a institute of learning because I learn everyday from it. I will be so excited to work with other hive experts in other to achieve these goals and make 2025 and amazing year for us all.
